proposed_source_context.population: 21 English-speaking adults, observed ages 19–68, recruited from one post-COVID clinic; interviews Aug–Sep 2022
proposed_source_context.condition_definition: Age ≥18, functioning well before infection, significant life impact ≥3 months after infection
proposed_source_context.setting: Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center post-COVID recovery clinic; internal physician referral
applicability_limits: Single academic specialty clinic; many participants had severe symptoms for 1–2 years.
No remote/nonattending population, no comparator, no quantitative effect; not the national 18–64 MEPS denominator.

proposed_source_context.population: Ten adult NHS long-COVID services participating in 2021–2023 collaborative
proposed_source_context.condition_definition: Adult service populations with locally varying eligibility; no single study-wide analytic denominator matched to MEPS
proposed_source_context.setting: NHS specialist adult long-COVID services; eight England, one Wales, one Scotland
proposed_source_context.payer: NHS; national funding and local pathways differ
applicability_limits: Service evaluation without causal comparator; secular changes and falling incidence affected waiting times.
NHS and local eligibility/funding cannot be silently transferred to US national/payer settings.

current_app_context_gap: The national analytic cohort and pathway/mechanism are known; target service setting and payer are not selected. Do not treat unspecified values as wildcard matches. Either independently define an exact fit-for-purpose context or withhold planning-option use; no new context UI is authorized here.
release_chain: Review covers candidate, source and exact map digests. Released catalog embeds review/map digests; independently approved allowlist pins released catalog/review/map digests and versions. Changing map requires a new release identity and review. No self-digest or circular hash.
